I implemented `Uint8Array.fromBase64` in `from_base64.rs`. All 26 runs under `built-ins/Uint8Array/fromBase64/` pass, up from 8, and `cargo clippy` is clean. I ran `cargo fmt` after the last test run, and didn't rebuild or re-test after it.

The file also holds the shared pieces for `setFromBase64`, all `pub(crate)`: the `Alphabet` and `LastChunkHandling` enums, `get_options_object`, `get_base64_options` (spec steps 3–8) and `from_base64_record` (FromBase64). `from_base64_record` returns the error as a message that the caller throws as a `SyntaxError`, so the spec's error record becomes `Option<&'static str>`.

I also wrote `SkipAsciiWhitespace` and the two chunk-decode helpers as private functions in the same file, and `get_options_object` there since nothing in the engine provided it.
